content.title: Place a bouquet order as a guest
content.description: A visitor completes the end-to-end purchase flow by adding an in-stock bouquet to the basket, seeing the basket total reflect what was added, choosing a delivery date that excludes Sundays, checking out without creating an account, and receiving an on-screen order confirmation with an order number; the same flow must work on a phone because the site is intended to take orders from mostly mobile, Instagram-led customers without Sarah’s direct involvement.
content.value: Captures revenue through self-serve online ordering without requiring staff or account creation.
criteria: guest checkout requires no account creation
a visitor can add a bouquet to the basket and the basket total updates to reflect what they added
out-of-stock bouquets are not addable to the basket
successful checkout shows an order confirmation with an order number
the checkout flow works on a phone

content.title: Receive online orders by email
content.description: Sarah receives each successfully placed order by email so the shop can process online purchases even when nobody is available to answer the phone or Instagram DMs, which is the operational mechanism this milestone uses to let the website take orders without her direct involvement at the moment of purchase.
content.value: Prevents missed orders by notifying the florist of successful online purchases.
criteria: a successful order sends the order to Sarah by email

content.title: Browse bouquet catalogue
content.description: A visitor browses the bouquet catalogue and can see the price of each bouquet before deciding whether to add anything to the basket, and this storefront discovery experience must also work on a phone because most customers arrive from Instagram on mobile devices.
content.value: Lets customers discover products and prices before starting an order.
criteria: the price of every bouquet is visible before anything is added to the basket
the storefront flow works on a phone
